title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct UCSB Library environments, from staffed commons and reservable rooms to quiet floors and access-controlled graduate spaces.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, first and second floors, Mountain Side
cards.notes: Set up in the Library’s two-floor commons when you need individual or group workspace, computers, and nearby study-room options.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose commons with individual and group study infrastructure.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons occupies the first and second floors of the Library’s Mountain Side and includes study spaces, computers, and group study rooms during Study Commons hours.
cards.access_notes: Study Commons access is for UCSB students, faculty, and staff with campus ID during designated hours; current hours vary by day and term.

cards.title: Group Study Room 1560A
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, first floor, Mountain Side
cards.notes: Bring at least one collaborator and use this listed drop-in room for a focused planning session, problem set, or shared screen work.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor drop-in room for small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 1560A is a drop-in Group Study Room on the first floor, Mountain Side; library group study rooms serve groups of two to ten UCSB affiliates.
cards.access_notes: For UCSB students, faculty, and staff in groups of two or more; this room is listed as drop-in rather than reservable.

cards.title: Sara Miller McCune Arts Library
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, first floor, Mountain Side
cards.notes: Choose a booth, desk, couch, or shared table in the arts-library area when you want varied seating alongside art and music collections.
cards.short_summary: An arts-focused library space with several seating formats.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sara Miller McCune Arts Library provides study spaces including booths, desks, couches, and shared tables on the first floor, Mountain Side of the main UCSB Library.
cards.source_title: Sara Miller McCune Arts Library opens for study, research and learning resources | UCSB Library
cards.access_notes: Located within the main UCSB Library; consult current Library hours and any room-specific reservation requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Pacific View Room
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, eighth floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet-area room for individual reading or writing, and keep conversations, group work, and calls elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A quiet eighth-floor study room with mountain and ocean views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pacific View Room is on the Library’s eighth floor and is identified as a quiet study area with wraparound views of the mountains and ocean.
cards.access_notes: The Library notes that special events are sometimes held in the Pacific View Room; check current Library conditions before relying on it.

cards.entity_name: UCSB Library Fifth Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Fifth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, fifth floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor for solo reading, drafting, or problem-solving; use headphones quietly and take calls outside the quiet area.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor for individual, low-noise study.
cards.evidence_claim: The fifth floor in the Ocean Side section of UCSB Library is designated for quiet study; group study and cell-phone conversations are not allowed.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-floor rules prohibit group study and phone conversations; Library building access and hours vary.

cards.entity_name: UCSB Library Sixth Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Sixth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, sixth floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Use this quiet floor for work that benefits from sustained concentration, keeping keyboarding minimal and audio low through headphones.
cards.short_summary: A sixth-floor individual-study setting governed by quiet rules.
cards.evidence_claim: The sixth floor in the Ocean Side section of UCSB Library is a designated quiet study floor where group study and phone conversations are not allowed.
cards.access_notes: Quiet-floor rules prohibit group study and phone conversations; Library building access and hours vary.

cards.entity_name: UCSB Library Seventh Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Seventh Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, seventh floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Bring independent work to this quiet floor and leave discussion-based tasks for a commons area or a designated group study room.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study floor near the Library’s seventh-floor collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSB Library’s seventh-floor Ocean Side map identifies the floor as a Quiet Floor, and the Library’s quiet-study policy prohibits group study and phone conversations there.
cards.source_title: UCSB Library 7th Floor Ocean Side Map | UCSB Library
cards.access_notes: Follow quiet-floor restrictions; current building access and hours are set by the Library.

cards.entity_name: UCSB Library Eighth Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Eighth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, eighth floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Use the eighth-floor quiet zone for solo study and keep calls and collaboration out of the area to preserve its stated purpose.
cards.short_summary: A designated top-floor quiet-study environment apart from the Pacific View Room.
cards.evidence_claim: The eighth floor in the Ocean Side section of UCSB Library is designated for quiet study; the Library prohibits group study and cell-phone conversations in quiet areas.
cards.access_notes: The Pacific View Room may host special events; quiet-floor access and Library hours vary by day.

cards.title: Graduate Study Room 2504
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, second floor, Mountain Side
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this access-card room for quiet, individual work; plan group meetings in a separate group-study location.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet reading-room environment for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Graduate Study Room 2504 is on the Library’s second-floor Mountain Side, is for quiet study only, and is available during all Late Night Study hours to eligible graduate students.
cards.access_notes: Exclusively for current UCSB graduate students using UCSB Access Cards; the room is available during all Late Night Study hours.

cards.title: Graduate Study Room 2582B
cards.subtitle: UCSB Library, second floor, Ocean Side
cards.notes: Graduate students can swipe into this quiet room for focused reading and writing, reserving conversation and group work for other spaces.
cards.short_summary: An Ocean Side graduate-only room for quiet individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Graduate Study Room 2582B is on the Library’s second-floor Ocean Side, is for quiet study only, and is available during all Late Night Study hours to eligible graduate students.
cards.access_notes: Exclusively for current UCSB graduate students using UCSB Access Cards; the room is available during all Late Night Study hours.
